from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Financial summary extracted from one company's filing regarding Total Assets."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial statement covers (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item as found in the document")
    reported_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the asset reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported value (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars', or None)")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., '10-Q')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
